name: Smith Machine Front Squat
steps: Set the bar across the fronts of your shoulders and grasp it from below with elbows raised.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart slightly ahead of the rails, brace your trunk and release the hooks.
Bend your hips and knees to squat as far as you can keep your heels down and the bar supported.
Drive firmly through your midfoot and heels to stand straight back up to the starting stance.
tips: Keep your elbows elevated throughout the squat so the bar stays securely cradled across your front delts.
Adjust your foot stance slightly forward so your torso stays tall and balanced against the vertical rail.
